Oncall Bot: INCIDENT: multiple 500s observed from the inference fleet for /v1/generate. Pager triggered for primary. Please acknowledge and follow runbook. https://runbook.internal/redwood/inference/500s :rotating_light:

Maria G: ack — I'm the current primary but stuck in transit on a train. ETA to be back on laptop ~00:30 UTC. I can do a short handoff if someone can be primary for ~90m. Sorry folks. :disappointed:

Sam R: I can pick up primary for that window. Taking pager now. Ping me if something spikes, I'll mute non-critical alerts. :handshake:

Liam O'Connor: I'll shadow as secondary and keep an eye on the logs/metrics. If Sam needs escalation ping me and I'll take the cross-region bridge.

Maria G: thank you. Quick handover notes (short):
- Active customers showing errors: 12 accounts hitting /api/generate with 5xx and timeouts.
- Likely source: worker OOMs on model-workers-asia pool after recent deploy at 23:40 UTC.
- Short mitigation steps in runbook: restart afflicted workers, roll back if restart fails, enable degraded-model routing.

Maria G: runbook excerpt:
```
1) Check alert group: https://metrics.redwood/alerts/500s-inference
2) SSH to model-worker nodes matching label model=redwood-13b and check dmesg/system logs
3) Try graceful restart: kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/model-worker --selector=zone=asia
4) If restarts >3 and errors persist, route traffic to fallback-model tag: redwood-13b-quantized
5) Notify CS with template: /incident update
```

Sam R: starting with step 1/2. I'm seeing OOMs on pod model-worker-asia-7. Restarting that pod now. Command I'll run:
```bash
kubectl -n inference delete pod model-worker-asia-7 --grace-period=30
```

AlertBot: Sam R acknowledged the pager and muted low-severity alerts for 90m. :white_check_mark:

Sam R: pod restarted. Watching logs — still seeing elevated GC/alloc churn, but error rate dropped from 48 rps to 12 rps in 2m.

Jess T: CS note — I've opened an incident ticket and messaged account owners for the 3 highest-affected customers. Status page draft: "Investigating increased 500 errors on text generation endpoints. Temporary mitigations underway." Should I publish?

Sam R: Yes publish the status page and include ETA 1h while we observe. Use this short blurb and mention workaround: retry with smaller payloads or use embedding endpoints where possible.

Liam O'Connor: I'll prepare degraded routing if the next restart doesn't stabilize. Plan: flip a percentage of traffic to redwood-13b-quantized and monitor quality/regression.

Maria G: If you need immediate rollback, tag rollback from last stable: image@sha256:abcd1234. Quick command:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-worker model-worker=registry/redwood/model-worker:stable-2026-02-28
```

Sam R: note — hooking up flamegraphs to the pod, looks like allocation spike from batching buffer growth at longer seq lengths. Lowering max_batch_tokens to 1024 as hotfix in config map. Applying now.

Sam R: hotfix applied to configmap; propagating — will observe for 10m. Error rate trending down to baseline ~2 rps.

Oncall Bot: Pager auto-silenced (by Sam R). Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.

Jess T: status page updated and CS notified. Customer impact: some requests timed out or returned 500s for ~18 minutes. I logged affected customer IDs in the ticket.

Maria G: thanks team. I'm still offline until 00:30 UTC — Sam/R on primary, Liam secondary confirmed. I'll rejoin when I'm back on laptop and do a full post-incident handoff.

Sam R: confirmed primary for 00:00–01:30 UTC. Liam secondary. I'll keep on-call notes in the incident ticket.

Liam O'Connor: leaving a short checklist for whoever takes next handoff:
- Confirm no new 5xx alerts for 30m
- Check queue/backpressure metrics and batch sizes
- Verify fallback-model routing not overused (>20% traffic)
- Close ticket if stable for 60m or escalate to infra if OOMs reappear

Maria G: appreciated. Leaving runbook pointers pinned to channel and incident ticket. :pushpin:

Sam R: handshake — primary handoff complete. :white_check_mark:

Jess T: I'll keep CS looped and update once final closure occurs.

Oncall Bot: Thread closed by Sam R (manual).
